findings.title: DOM XSS: comment body parsed as HTML via innerHTML
findings.evidence: The only change replaces 'el.textContent = comment.body;' with 'el.innerHTML = comment.body;', so the comment body string is handed to the HTML parser instead of being treated as text. Reachable path: comment.body comes from stored/reflected user content; a value such as '' (or '
findings.recommendation: Revert to textContent (or build nodes/append text nodes) so the body is never parsed as markup. If limited formatting is genuinely required, sanitize with a vetted sanitizer (e.g. DOMPurify with an explicit allow-list) before assignment, and add a regression test asserting that a body containing '' produces no element node / no handler attribute.
